# Smart Sites by ParentSquare

> > A comprehensive platform for creating and managing responsive school district websites with customizable design templates and professional components.

Smart Sites by ParentSquare is a website builder platform designed specifically for K-12 school districts, offering pre-built design templates (Denali, Saguaro, Rainier), a component library, and implementation guidance. The platform emphasizes accessibility, responsive design, and school-specific branding customization.

- Smart Sites

- [Component Library](https://smartsites.parentsquare.com/11208_1): Smart Sites component library and design system documentation
